evidence.detail: R399 ModelRecolorTransform constructs one nested instance per int[][][] recolor group, stores that group's source-color ids in an int set and stores the group's destination int[] sequence.
The nested a() method returns the current destination color, increments its cursor and wraps the cursor to zero at the end of the destination array.
ModelRecolorTransform tests each model color/id against each nested source set and, on a matching group, replaces that value with the nested cycle's next destination color.
R399 already fixes the enclosing class as ModelRecolorTransform and explicitly identifies per-source cyclic destination sequences as part of its exact recolor behavior.
